summary.headline: The Tricentennial Committee finalized drone show plans for January 2027 and coordinated budgets and logistics across multiple celebratory events.
summary.summary: The Southborough Tricentennial Committee reviewed progress across numerous events planned for the town 300th anniversary celebration in 2027. Highlights included contracting Firefly for a 200-drone aerial light show on New Year Day 2027, featuring designs created through a student art competition. The committee also advanced preparations for an expanded August 2027 music festival, an antique fire engine muster, commemorative tree plantings, and a town-wide brick fundraiser.

topics.title: Historical music research and concert planning
topics.summary: Guest researcher Juliana Perez presented historical findings regarding Southborough music, including sheet music, church music, and historical connections to Fay School. The committee discussed helping locate private local music collections and developing a period-appropriate chamber music performance for late 2025 or 2026.
key_details: Research explored historical pieces connected to composer Lowell Mason, Charles Ives, and Sarah Sartell Prentice
Perez is seeking access to historical private collections, letters, and musical archives in Southborough
The committee suggested coordinating with local historians, the historical commission, and community blogs
A live period performance is tentatively envisioned for late next year
topics.outcome: Committee members agreed to connect Perez with local historians and draft a call to action for residents with historical sheet music.

topics.title: Routine business
topics.summary: The committee conducted routine administrative business, reviewing and approving past meeting records.
key_details: Approved meeting minutes from August 12, 2024, with minor typographical edits
Approved meeting minutes from September 16, 2024, with minor formatting adjustments
topics.outcome: Both sets of minutes approved unanimously.

topics.title: Utility pole banner coordination
topics.summary: Town staff updated the committee on communications with utility companies regarding permissions to hang tricentennial banners from utility poles.
key_details: Initial list of 87 poles has been reduced to 67 poles
Capping the request at 50 poles or fewer eliminates inspection fees from utility companies
Staff are preparing required insurance and administrative paperwork
topics.outcome: The committee directed staff to finalize a list of 50 poles to avoid utility inspection fees.

topics.title: Sub-working group updates and event registration
topics.summary: The committee discussed planting daffodils around the Town House and reviewed the planned setup for event ticketing and registration through the Bloomerang system.
key_details: Southborough Gardeners have over 100 daffodil bulbs ready to plant near the Town House flagpole
DPW raised concerns about squirrel disruption and will recommend the best planting spot
Event registration via the Bloomerang software platform is scheduled to go live by December 1
topics.outcome: DPW staff will advise on planting locations, and registration configuration will be finalized in November.

topics.title: August 2027 music festival planning
topics.summary: Working group organizers outlined plans to expand the annual Summer Nights event into a full-day music festival on Saturday, August 21, 2027. The event will showcase local performers across various musical genres and feature food trucks, a contra dance, and fireworks.
key_details: Scheduled for Saturday, August 21, 2027, starting in the early afternoon and ending with fireworks
Organizers are finalizing an agreement with a headliner band to determine stage and audio requirements
An accessibility grant application is being submitted to fund shuttle transportation and hospitality tents
School policy prohibits alcohol on school grounds, so organizers are checking property parcel boundaries regarding a potential beer garden
topics.outcome: Organizers will meet with public safety departments and town administration to confirm stage placement and permit options.

topics.title: History Makers nominations and historic event updates
topics.summary: The committee reviewed progress on educational and historical initiatives, including the newly launched History Makers recognition project and research into historic cemetery tours.
key_details: History Makers nomination form is live online to recognize notable past and present Southborough residents
Working group members plan to observe Worcester Rural Cemetery event to inform Southborough Voices from the Grave tour
Vendor contracts for parade cannons and oxen are expected to be finalized in January 2027
topics.outcome: Nominations will continue to be collected online through town channels.

topics.title: First Night and First Day 2027 celebrations
topics.summary: The committee reviewed arrangements for the tricentennial kickoff on January 1, 2027, centered around a 200-drone aerial light show produced by Firefly. Members also discussed site logistics, potential student artwork integration, bonfire safety concerns, and transportation.
key_details: A contract has been executed with Firefly for a 15-minute, 200-drone show on January 1, 2027, at 5:00 PM
St. Mark School field will serve as the drone launch area, with spectator viewing at Woodward School parking lot
Show will feature 20 formations, including six custom designs, two of which will be designed by local Trottier Middle School students
Student contest art submissions are due November 17, with winners selected before Thanksgiving
A traditional horse-drawn hayride was rejected after quotes exceeded $5,000, prompting consideration of a tractor-pulled wagon
Bonfire location is being reconsidered due to turf and wiring concerns at Woodward, with Finn School or a later winter date under review
topics.outcome: Working group members will coordinate site walks with town emergency personnel and finalize event details at the November meeting.
topics.why_it_matters: This major public event marks the official start of the town tricentennial year and will require significant logistical and public safety coordination across multiple municipal properties.

topics.title: Antique Fireman Muster
topics.summary: Organizers reported on preparations for an antique hand tub fire engine muster competition scheduled for 2027 at the Neary School fields.
key_details: Eight hand tubs have confirmed attendance, with 16 to 20 expected from across New England
The committee confirmed an approved budget allocation of $25,000 for the muster
Event will feature food catering from Sirloin Catering and live music from local band Tension
Southborough two historic tubs are currently undergoing restoration for competition
topics.outcome: A site layout map and detailed logistics will be presented at the November meeting.

topics.title: Legacy trees and time capsule updates
topics.summary: The committee discussed memorial tree plantings and the preservation standards for the town 300th anniversary time capsule.
key_details: Four native tree species have been submitted to the town tree warden for review and spring planting
Time capsule will measure approximately 2 feet by 2 feet by 2 feet with indoor storage at the Harvard Depository
Invitations will be sent to local civic organizations, clubs, and schools to submit historical artifacts and archival-grade photo prints
topics.outcome: Working groups will finalize tree selections and issue formal time capsule submission invitations to local organizations.

topics.title: Incorporation Day ceremony outline
topics.summary: Members reviewed a draft outline for the official town Incorporation Day ceremony and scheduled a formal briefing for the Select Board.
key_details: Working group drafted a three-page outline detailing ceremonial activities
Staff and committee representatives plan to meet with the town administrator to refine details
A formal presentation to the Select Board is targeted for their first meeting in December
topics.outcome: Committee will prepare slides and documentation for a presentation to the Select Board in December.

topics.title: Commemorative brick fundraiser
topics.summary: Organizers reported on promotional efforts and order deadlines for the tricentennial commemorative brick sales.
key_details: Promotional postcards were mailed to 3,847 households across town
Extra postcards are being placed at the Senior Center, Town House, and other public venues
Brick orders will be finalized in mid-November for manufacturing over the winter and spring installation
topics.outcome: The committee will continue promoting brick orders on town and community social media pages through mid-November.

topics.title: Heritage Day debrief and 2027 parade planning
topics.summary: The committee discussed observations from the recent 2024 Heritage Day parade and evaluated adjustments needed for a larger, supersized parade in 2027.
key_details: Heritage Day parade ran roughly 25 minutes along Main Street, ending near St. Mark field
Members discussed relocating the parade de-staging area to Common Street and St. Mark Street rather than Neary School
Because 2027 Heritage Day will occur on a Sunday, parade kickoff is proposed for 1:00 PM to accommodate morning church services
Organizers are considering Revolutionary War reenactment battles and artillery firing at St. Mark field or Ward Park
topics.outcome: Parade organizers will coordinate route and staging proposals with the police and fire departments.

upcoming.what: Trottier Middle School student drone art design submission deadline
Tricentennial commemorative brick order placement deadline
Tricentennial Committee update presentation to the Select Board

summary.caveats: The video title and chair verbally referenced the year 2026, but the recording date overlay, discussion of the upcoming October 2024 Special Town Meeting, and municipal calendar confirm the meeting took place on October 14, 2024.
